source_evidence: Player exact 'Continue' from ordinary crossing queue authorizes routine passage and onward travel, not payment/voluntary surrender or attack. Existing shared trade culture/armistice source world/politics/human-states.md; ordinary inspections without special hindrance or disclosure. Actual D320 crossing, sister branches to village, shared camp with carter, full day debit and qualifying LR at dawn321; no D320 night roll. Actual visible Python secrets occurrence21/type57 receipt 97dc9ee210d5868921b14c722696fed5 and severity56 receipt 6aa3d52dc96f5f2121ffc1c379c47f1a from predeclared bands/groups; fixed serious roster 1 captain,1 veteran,2 thugs,3 scouts. No attack/initiative yet. G1 separate local road gang with finite means/credible commercial target, no forced link to Crown investigation; G2 visible demand, player may confront, negotiate, retreat or choose another approach; G3 predeclared risk/caps/severity, actual roster and geometry fixed, official 2014 Basic Rules fallback verification and approved mirror content unavailable, HOLD on exact mirror confirmation before tactical activation or explicitly disclose temporary official rules fallback; no promised reward or forced fight. D321~10:30, Ossent side of militarized frontier, westbound toward Orsaven. Ordinary commercial crossing completed D320 afternoon after routine coach/passenger and merchant cargo inspection; no special fee charged to V, no sealed diplomatic packet opened/disclosed. Carter's sister voluntarily parts at branch to family village; carter and wool wagon continue independently alongside party, no paid escort or extra party supply charge. D320 full-day supplies debit12→9 ration person-days,16→12 feed units; exposed quiet night D320→321 has no random occurrence roll because D320 already had social event, qualifies weighted LR5+1→6, completes LR dawn321, reset0/6; all HP/features full before and after; no extra recovery grant. D321 morning routine Tamsin contact per standing procedure, no specific new estate outcome asserted. D321 frontier uplands day30/night20 tier fixed, actual d100 occurrence21, type57 dangerous humanoids, severity56 serious. D320 and D321 are consecutive encounter days, leg encounter count2/5; no D321 random night roll, D322 next ordinary travel day mandatory quiet. D321 partial morning, no full-day provision charge yet:9/12 (three days before charge), planned leg D317–324; resupply needed before fourth remaining day, no spending yet. D321~10:30 both wagons halt before seven clearly visible independent armed highway raiders trying to seize goods/valuables, unrelated to prepared Pennant operation, no classified knowledge, no extra hidden foes or reinforcements. Finite fixed roster from severity predeclared: C Bandit Captain CR2 AC15 HP65 Dex+3, Vt Veteran CR3 AC17 HP58 Dex+1, T1/T2 Thug CR1/2 AC11 HP32 Dex+0, S1/S2/S3 Scout CR1/2 AC13 HP16 Dex+2; total1650 base XP ×2.5=4125 adjusted, hard versus campaign three-level7 baseline. All speed30. Profiles crosschecked with D&D Beyond 2014 Basic Rules after approved mirror file content returned empty (mirror blob ea2a16def25116746411fa1de80c346444228759 identified but contents not verified); before tactical rolls/combat obtain approved mirror records or disclose and use clearly marked temporary 2014 official-source ruling if unavailable. Fixed terrain at halt: west=positive x, road width20ft y±10; own coach centered(0,0), V inside, Cirren inside, Mara driver at front bench x5, Fenar on coach roof; horse team x10–20; merchant wagon centered(-40,0), merchant on bench, horse team x-30–-20. C(60,0) visible with scimitar; Vt(65,5) with drawn longsword/shortsword; T1(55,8),T2(55,-8) with maces and crossbows carried; S1(40,25),S2(40,-25),S3(70,25) visibly aiming longbows from sparse roadside stone walls/brush providing half cover against blocked lines. Open road behind east, modest slope and brush to sides; no bridge, trap, hidden ambushers or forced surprise. Captain calls for wagons halted, valuables and wool surrendered; no attack, surprise, initiative, resource use or threat response yet. Gang wants goods, not suicidal fight; armed resistance triggers lethal tactics, can retreat if leader disabled or majority down, no waves; approach, fight, negotiation or retreat genuinely available. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 Boots Elvenkind; Mara and owned horses/coach healthy. Purse3178gp4sp6cp, all prior authorized loot sales completed; no new cash/loot, no promise to merchant. Sealed diplomatic letter/limited credentials and Kestrel originals V-held, Mara notes, Fenar physical evidence, Cirren compact; commission remaining300+1300, scholarly300/800; Elara Caereth, Severin reply pending. V dice delegated until stop. Await V response to raiders.
